say:1:1231159001:1.text: There's just so much I'm not used to!
say:1:1231159001:1.source_cn: 我不习惯的地方可太多了！

say:2:1231159002:1.text: First of all, the service at the inn is dreadful. I've traveled all over, and I've never been treated so rudely.
say:2:1231159002:1.source_cn: 首先就是这家旅馆的服务，我去了那么多地方，还没见过服务...

say:3:1231159003:1.text: And then there's the bed in the room—I've never seen anything like it! It's so damp you could ring enough water out of it to fill a bucket!
say:3:1231159003:1.source_cn: 还有房间的床铺，自我入住，从来都没干过！简直可以拧出水来！
